encoding._packed_hex: point as 32 bytes: y little-endian, bit 7 of byte 31 set iff x > (p - 1) / 2
encoding._bits_hex: ceil(gamma / 8) bytes; bit i is bit (i & 7) of byte (i >> 3)
encoding.aes: AES-128, one raw block (ECB, no padding), key dvk
encoding.address: bech32m payload: d_bytes || pk_d packed || pk as 32 LE bytes || ck_d packed
encoding.osk_preimage: osk domain || ock || chain id as 32 LE bytes || rho as 32 LE bytes || asset as 8 LE bytes || value as 8 LE bytes || d_bytes || pk_d packed || pk as 32 LE bytes || ck_d packed || nullifier count as 1 byte || each nullifier as 32 LE bytes; osk is its blake2b-256
encoding.plaintext: asset as 8 LE bytes || value as 8 LE bytes || rho as 32 LE bytes || rseed || d_bytes
encoding.ciphertext: 2 bytes, the big-endian integer whose bit i is clue bit i, then ChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce, plaintext) with its 16-byte tag; key = blake2b-256(kdf domain || epk packed || (esk * pk_d) packed), nonce = blake2b-96(nonce domain || epk packed)
